verdict.rationale: GoDaddy's evidence covers domain, DNS, forwarding and commerce APIs, plus a CLI, an agent skill and an MCP server. Nothing in the pack documents a way to version, review or roll back automations. DNS record replacement and irreversible registration operations are adjacent API behaviors, not versioned automation management, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
